title: Toward 60 fps: hazel-jit So Far
kind: synthesis of reports 045 to 049, with measurements of its own: eight builds of one branch, work in progress
question: Where do Hazel's livelits stand against a 60 fps floor for small edits, after a week of compiling them to JavaScript (reports 045 to 049)? Matthew, 2026-11-08, for the meeting with Cyrus on 2026-11-11.
measurements: Eight builds of hazelgrove/hazel trial/694-view-jit, each the one before it plus one change, each a release build measured by scripts/jit_slides.py in Firefox on GitHub's machines (jit.yml) on 2026-11-08: the Witch slide's four slider steps each way (ms from the step to the picture changing), and from build 5 on a 3-second drag of the neck slider, compiled and not, every frame timed with requestAnimationFrame (frames in ms). Builds 1 to 3 are report 046's runs (046/data/witch), build 4 is report 049's (049/data/runs), builds 5 to 8 and two repeat runs of build 7 are here in runs/.
